name: Norfork Tailwater
description: The cold-water North Fork River below Norfork Dam joins the White River at Norfork, Arkansas. The boat corridor runs from Dam-Quarry Boat Ramp to Norfork Access on the White River just below the confluence. Releases can change conditions along this reach; observed dam readings and generation schedules do not establish a safe wading or departure window. Check the current Arkansas Game and Fish Commission trout regulations for the section you fish.
managingAuthority: USACE Little Rock District; Arkansas Game and Fish Commission
